questions.title: Fix Directory Access
questions.scenario: Developers need read/write access to /var/www/app. Write the commands to set proper group ownership and permissions so that the developers group can modify files.

questions.title: Create & Assign Group
questions.scenario: Ensure all developers belong to the developers group. So, write the command to add user dev3 to the developers group.

questions.title: Audit Sudo Access
questions.scenario: The manager suspects too many users have sudo privileges. Write the command to list all users who have sudo access.

questions.title: Investigate Suspicious Login
questions.scenario: There are multiple failed SSH login attempts. Write the command to find failed SSH login attempts from system logs.
